story_title: How Podium Armed 10,000+ Local Businesses with AI Agents
caption:
While the internet debates when AI agents will arrive, over 10,000 local businesses are already using one.

Podium integrated OpenAI’s GPT-5 models to build 'Jerry'—an autonomous AI teammate handling customer service and operations for local businesses. The result? Up to 300% growth in engagement.

The biggest AI shift isn't just happening in Silicon Valley. It's happening on Main Street.
